items.claim: Lucas Fernando will win the fight via knockout.
items.quote: Lucas Fernando via knockout is my official prediction.

items.quote: Magny coming into this fight 31 wins 14 losses absolute veteran record. I'm pretty sure that's the most fights out of any fighter on the entire fight card.
